prompt: Implement durable dirty-checkout recovery for the orchestrator host. Add tests for clean fast-forward, valid dirty layer, invalid dirty layer, concurrent writer, and upstream overlap.
proof: New dirty-checkout recovery tests pass and a fixture repo 16 commits behind with compatible local edits converges to a clean layered head without data loss.
note: The live host remained behind because 26 tracked changes blocked auto-pull; this closes that indefinite stall mode.
